mentions.name: Yard-tree hand-plane furniture build
mentions.description: This hand-tool woodworking project uses hand planes to flatten a hardwood slab (and dimensional lumber) milled from a tree felled in the builder's yard, undertaken as a hands-on retreat from AI/digital overload, with the goal of making furniture.
mentions.problem: AI/digital overload prompting a hands-on, analog woodworking project
mentions.source_excerpt: Having AI/digital overload, I purchased some hand planes and am flatting a hardwood slab (and dimensional) that I had milled from a tree felled in my yard in order to make some furniture.
